main_text.head: SECT. XIII.
main_text.p: Cafus41Reftat Quintum Dubium, nulliusferè difficultatis, & paucissimis absolvendum, de Juramento, ubi solennitatis aliqua pars ob dignitatem personæ omittitur. Ut quando Principi, Satrapæ, aut Magnati juramentum defertur munus aliquod honorarium suscipienti, omissis ritibus ordinariis (ut libri tactu, & ofculo &c.) præleƈtis verbis in quæ jurandum est, admonetur tantùm ut promittat in verbo Principis, aut in verbo honoris sui &c. se fideliter prædicta observaturum. Cui monitioni si admota pectori manu respondeat tantùm se id polliceri, Juramentum jam pro præstito & perac̈to ha-betur. In hoc casu dico breviter, juratum non minùs obligari in conscientiâ, ad fideliter præstandum ea quæ sic pollicitus est, quàm si singula verba & syllabas ipse uo ore pronunciasset, & reliqua solennia exactissimè peregisset. Atque hæc de juramenti Formâ externâ dicta sunto. Expectabatis forsitan, quod & mihi constitutum erat, ut hac prælectione complesterer & ea quæ ad Internam formam pertinent. Sed continet ea pars dubia quædam

page.notes: The small marks under the last line (near the catchword) are probably a signature or printer's marks; they are not transcribed. The marginal note "Cafus41" may be read as "Casus 41". The ct ligature in "tactu", "præleƈtis" and "perac̈to" is rendered as ct. The line-end hyphen in "ha-betur" is printed. Long s has been set as plain s.
